judgments.reason: The support span 'Diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes in the dermis (hematoxylin-eosin stain)' appears literally in the vignette under the skin biopsy image description, and foamy histiocyte infiltration is a hallmark histological feature of lepromatous leprosy, clinically supporting this subtype designation.

The support span 'Numerous acid-fast bacilli present (acid-fast stain)' appears literally in the vignette as an additional finding from the skin biopsy, and a high bacillary load on acid-fast stain is a defining feature of lepromatous leprosy, clinically supporting this subtype designation.
